description: This file defines a custom exception class DdlParserException used within the MigraDoc library to represent errors thrown by the DDL parser. It includes constructors for initializing the exception with different types of error information and holds a DdlReaderError object describing the specific error.

classes.name: DdlParserException
classes.description: A sealed class representing exceptions specifically issued by the DDL parser within MigraDoc. It extends System.Exception and includes additional error details via the DdlReaderError property.

methods.name: DdlParserException(MdDomMsg, Exception?)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a message derived from MdDomMsg and an optional inner exception.

methods.name: DdlParserException(DdlReaderError, Exception?)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a provided DdlReaderError object and an optional inner exception.
